articles.title: U.S. Navy Assists Mariners Experiencing Engine Trouble in Arabian Sea
articles.summary: ARABIAN SEA (Nov. 1, 2026) - The U.S. Navy assisted five mariners aboard the Indian-flagged Motor Vessel (M/V) Mira, after the dhow experienced a power failure in the Arabian Sea, Oct. 31.
